decisions.reason: The transactional email service is a flagship product that extends the firm's core messaging expertise and its own infrastructure, so the firm can readily interpret its results and keep improving it.
Managed capture has a documented customer reference and fits the firm's electronic document workflow knowledge, giving it a solid basis for continued assimilation and development.
Email and fax conversion sits squarely within the firm's established messaging competence and serves regulated customers who still rely on fax, so it is cheap to maintain and well understood.
The fax delivery optimization feature is close to the core fax offering and builds on existing technical knowledge, so it makes sense to keep it as part of the established service.

Sandbox threat protection strengthens the firm's email security portfolio with knowledge it has developed in-house, and it likely absorbed the role of the dropped multi-engine scanning feature, making it strategically relevant.
